title: Chapter 706 - 706 Reincarnation Of The Immortal Phoenix; Abandon Mission!
content:
Chapter 706 - 706 Reincarnation Of The Immortal Phoenix; Abandon Mission!

Chapter 706 - 706 Reincarnation of the Immortal Phoenix; Abandon Mission!

706 Reincarnation of the Immortal Phoenix; Abandon Mission!

“Lin Fan, when did you come in?” Dai Weixue scolded. “Get out, get out!”

As she spoke, she kept pushing Lin Fan out.

Lin Fan bent down and kissed Qiu Ziqian’s forehead. “I’ll wait for you outside.”

“Alright,” Qiu Ziqian replied.

Not long after Lin Fan arrived outside…

Thick clouds suddenly gathered from afar.

They covered the sky.

The entire world instantly darkened.

It was like nighttime.

In the next moment…

A huge hole appeared in the clouds, as if the sky had broken.

Dazzling golden light shot down from the hole, illuminating the entire villa in a golden and bright color. It emitted a holy and auspicious aura.

A melodious phoenix cry could be heard from the golden light.

[Ding! Immortal Phoenix Reincarnation detected.]

[Immortal Phoenix. Cultivation: Unknown. Because they were attacked by an enemy, they had no choice but to choose a wisp of their soul to escape. They have chosen to reincarnate.]

When Lin Fan heard that, he raised his brows and said hurriedly, “Can I stop him from reincarnating?”

[It costs 10,000 spirit stones. Do you wish to proceed?]

“Can I ask a question?”

[Yes!]

“Will the child be affected after we stop it?”

[The child will die.]

Lin Fan could not help but hesitate.

For more than ten years, Qiu Ziqian had been looking forward to the birth of her child.

If she gave birth to a dead baby, how sad would she be?

Lin Fan continued, “After the child is born, will he have the memories of the Immortal Phoenix? Or will the child be influenced by the Immortal Phoenix?”

[The answer costs 10,000 spirit stones. Do you wish to proceed?]

“Yes!”

[Before the child’s cultivation reaches the Emperor level, they will not have the memories of the Immortal Phoenix, nor will they be affected.]

Only when the child reached the Emperor level would their past memories awaken!

As expected, the Immortal Phoenix was very strong.

When Lin Fan heard that, he heaved a sigh of relief.

For the time being, the child would be fine.

At this moment, a loud baby’s cry came from the villa, echoing in the entire villa.

Then, Dai Weixue carried a cute and nimble little girl who was as clear as jade and walked out quickly.

The rhythm of her breathing was very strange. The surrounding spiritual energy formed a spiral and quickly surged into her body.

This was a mysterious breathing technique.

Then, the little girl grew rapidly at a speed visible to the naked eye.

The little girl only stopped growing when she was close to a meter tall.

This change surprised everyone around.

Dai Weixue stuttered a little and said, “This… This…”

Lin Fan smiled and said, “Seems like we don’t have to worry much in the future.”

Dai Weixue saw Lin Fan’s relaxed tone and felt relieved.

“Yulian, call me ‘Grandma’,” she said kindly.

“G-Grandma…” Lin Yulian blinked her big eyes and then let out a crisp and pleasant voice.

When Dai Weixue heard this, she immediately broke into a smile. “Hehehe, our Yulian is so obedient!”

She only asked tentatively, but she did not expect Lin Yulian to really call her that.

“Yulian, call me ‘Aunt’!” Lin Xiaoyao hurriedly said.

“Aunt!” Lin Yulian’s voice was even louder and clearer.

“Good child!” Lin Xiaoyao said happily. “Yulian is so obedient! You’re much better than your brother! If you want something fun or delicious, just say it! I’ll buy it all for you.”

“Call me ‘Daddy’,” Lin Fan said.

“Daddy!” Lin Yulian said.

“Good girl.” Lin Fan smiled and patted her head.

Then, Hu Tian, Xia Xue, Xia Bing, Su Ningjing… also asked Lin Yulian to call out to them.

Lin Yulian kept shouting, making everyone extremely happy. The entire Coiling Dragon Villa was enveloped in joy.

…

In the blink of an eye, three years had passed.

“Yulian, it’s time to eat!”

“Coming!”

A little girl about 1.4 meters tall jogged over.

It was Lin Yulian.

At the age of three, she was already 1.4 meters tall. She already had a slim and elegant appearance.

Lin Fan, Hu Tian, Xia Bing, Xia Xue, Su Ningjing, and the rest of the family were all gathered together. It was extremely warm.

After she ate her fill, a little bird flew over the treetops, attracting Lin Yulian’s attention.

“Yulian, do you want to fly like a bird?” Lin Chengzhen asked.

Lin Yulian’s big eyes immediately shone like gems.

“Yes!” she said excitedly.

Lin Chengzhen finally found his purpose as her brother and said happily, “Alright, I’ll teach you.

“Let me teach you a flying technique first…

“According to the Qi Method, inject energy into your legs. After which, slowly rise…”

As he spoke, he circulated his energy, and his entire body soared.

“Yulian, you see…”

However, before Lin Chengzhen could finish, his eyes widened.

Lin Yulian was already flying in the air. She was moving up, down, left, and right in the air. She was light and agile.

Then, she sped up and shot into the distance, raising a gust of wind that made Lin Chengzhen’s clothes and hair rustle.

“Like this, Brother?” Lin Yulian asked happily. “It’s so fun! I’m flying so fast!”

A layer of cold sweat appeared on Lin Chengzhen’s forehead as he stuttered, “Yes… Just like that…”

Although he had been practicing flying movement techniques for some time, he was still unable to do it as easily and freely as Lin Yulian.

In other words, his sister had surpassed him as soon as she started cultivating.

As an elder brother, he really could not bear to face the others.

Not far away, Lin Fan, Hu Tian, Su Ningjing, Xia Bing, Xia Xue, and the others looked at Lin Yulian’s happy appearance and Lin Chengzhen’s embarrassed appearance. They laughed out loud.

At this moment, a crisp notification rang out in Lin Fan’s mind.

[Ding! Mission: Enter the Bloodbath World. Reward: Transcendence Golden Body x1, God-Slaying Sword (Emperor), Immortal Crystal x1, ten billion experience points.]

Lin Fan chose to ignore it.

He had entered secret realms before, such as the Heavenly Wind World.

Lin Fan had obtained some Spiritual Fruits and equipment in the Heavenly Wind World.

To an ordinary person, this was considered a bountiful harvest.

To Lin Fan, however, it was nothing.

Furthermore, Lin Fan had never heard of the Bloodbath World before. If he entered it, he might have to spend quite some time inside.

With this time, Lin Fan might as well stay at home and cultivate.

…

Time passed like water, and two years passed in a flash.

On this day, Lin Fan heard another crisp notification in his mind.

[Ding! You’ve chosen to abandon the mission—enter the Bloodbath World. You’ve obtained Transcendence Golden Body x1, Immortal Crystal x1, Fire Spirit Crystal x1, ten billion experience points.]

The energy surged into Lin Fan’s body.

Lin Fan looked at the Transcendence Golden Body in front of him, the Immortal Crystals that were filled with pure energy, and the Fire Spirit Crystal that was emitting a scorching heat. His face revealed a strange look.

In other words… Even if he did not complete the mission, he could still receive rewards?

Moreover, the rewards were no worse than the rewards for completing the mission!
